consequences_of_change: Higher resolution increases noise and memory; lower resolution merges multi-component CME substructure and blurs leading edge.

mathematical_role: Running difference temporal interval delta_t
scientific_justification: SECCHI COR2-A science observations during 2010 nominal phase targeted a 30-minute cadence for coronal dynamic difference imaging.
evidence: SECCHI mission operations logs confirm 30-minute base exposure cycle for COR2 coronagraph.
consequences_of_change: Changing interval alters RD flux amplitude (DN/s) and limits detectable CME velocity dynamic range.

mathematical_role: Maximum allowed deviation from nominal 1800s cadence
scientific_justification: Accommodates minor onboard spacecraft clock jitter and telemetry packet timestamp quantization.
evidence: Distribution of telemetry timestamp deltas in 2010 COR2 data shows +/-1s packet arrival variance.
consequences_of_change: Tighter tolerance rejects valid 30-minute frames; looser tolerance risks blending differing physical dynamic phases.

mathematical_role: Onboard bitshift and compression scaling factor correction
scientific_justification: Reconstructs true detector counts from losslessly compressed SECCHI onboard image processor (SEBIP) bitshifts.
evidence: SECCHI Flight Software Instrument Calibration Handbook (Howard et al. 2008).
consequences_of_change: Omitting SEBIP causes discontinuous 2x to 64x image intensity jumps across frames.

mathematical_role: Subtracted electronic bias pedestal normalized by exposure time
scientific_justification: Removes dark current and analog-to-digital converter (ADC) zero-level offset prior to science differencing.
evidence: SECCHI pre-flight dark calibration frames and daily calibration roll sequences.
consequences_of_change: Incorrect bias leaves systematic non-zero background pedestals in dark corners of the CCD.

mathematical_role: Validity threshold for downsampled 8x8 occulter mask blocks
scientific_justification: Requires that at least 95% of native 2048x2048 pixels within a 256x256 bin are unvignetted to consider the bin valid.
evidence: Selected during historical Stage 26 pipeline development to prevent pylon stray light leakage.
consequences_of_change: Lowering threshold admits noisy pylon and occulter rim boundary pixels; raising it excludes legitimate inner coronal data.

mathematical_role: Interpolation order for celestial North-up reprojection
scientific_justification: Bilinear interpolation balances flux conservation and spatial smoothness without ringing artifacts around sharp occulter edges.
evidence: Standard astronomical WCS image reprojection practice (Astropy reproject).
consequences_of_change: Nearest-neighbor introduces pixel quantization jitter; bicubic introduces negative ringing around bright stars.

mathematical_role: Interpolation order for binary validity and occulter mask reprojection
scientific_justification: Preserves strictly binary valid/invalid flag semantics without fractional boundary blurring.
evidence: Mathematical property of boolean spatial indicators.
consequences_of_change: Higher-order interpolation creates fractional boundary values requiring arbitrary post-thresholding.

mathematical_role: Number of preceding days acquired to populate causal 24h background history
scientific_justification: Ensures trailing 24-hour circular buffer is fully saturated with valid observations before the evaluation date begins.
evidence: T24 threshold estimator requires historical observations; 2 days covers potential cadence gaps.
consequences_of_change: Setting <1 day causes missing history (NO_HISTORY) on the evaluation day; >3 days increases download overhead.

mathematical_role: Block sizes for hierarchical multi-scale coronal patch decomposition
scientific_justification: Hierarchical quadtree-like patch decomposition enables multi-scale sensitivity: P16 captures bulk CME core, P04 delineates leading edge.

consequences_of_change: Altering scales changes patch dimensions and breaks hardcoded spatial coordinate assumptions in tracking.

mathematical_role: Spatial filter applied to running-difference image prior to standardization
scientific_justification: Normalized Gaussian convolution with valid mask avoids NaN contamination near occulter borders.
evidence: Empirical ablation showed Gaussian filter provided smoother z-score tails than 3x3 median.
consequences_of_change: Median denoiser exhibits higher variance in sparse coronagraph backgrounds.

mathematical_role: Standard deviation of Gaussian smoothing kernel
scientific_justification: Matches typical point-spread function (PSF) and cosmic ray speckle scale in 256x256 binned COR2 frames.
evidence: Empirical inspection showed sigma=1.0 suppresses single-pixel cosmic ray hits without blurring CME frontal shock.
consequences_of_change: Larger sigma blurs fine filamentary CME fronts; smaller sigma leaves salt-and-pepper noise.

mathematical_role: Running-difference pixel standardization transformation
scientific_justification: Absolute value |z| captures both mass addition (bright front) and mass depletion (dark cavity/dimming) characteristic of CMEs.
evidence: Physical CME structures in RD consist of a bright compression front followed by a depleted coronal cavity.

mathematical_role: Summary statistic of standardized pixel scores within each patch
scientific_justification: P95 acts as a robust upper-envelope estimator, sensitive to coherent structure occupying >5% of patch area while ignoring noise.
evidence: Percentile estimators resist single-pixel outliers better than maximum and have higher detection sensitivity than mean.
consequences_of_change: Lower percentiles dilute thin CME fronts; P100 (maximum) is vulnerable to residual cosmic rays.

mathematical_role: Minimum fraction of valid detector pixels required to accept a patch
scientific_justification: Prevents patches at the extreme occulter or vignetted border with minimal valid area from producing spurious high scores.
evidence: Heuristic standard from Stage 05 legacy detector.
consequences_of_change: Lowering admits high-noise edge patches; raising creates an artificial exclusion ring around the occulter.

mathematical_role: Temporal duration of trailing quiet-Sun observation buffer
scientific_justification: 24 hours matches the diurnal thermal and orbital periodicity of background coronal streamer evolution.
evidence: Coronal streamer brightness fluctuates on ~24-hour cycles; trailing 24h provides a statistically stable quiet baseline.
consequences_of_change: Shorter window increases threshold noise during quiet periods; longer window risks incorporating seasonal solar drift.

mathematical_role: Multiplier on robust standard deviation for causal detection threshold
scientific_justification: Equivalent to 3-sigma false-alarm rejection under a normal distribution (P(Z > 3) = 0.00135).
evidence: Standard statistical hypothesis testing threshold for anomaly detection in Gaussian-like residual noise.
consequences_of_change: Higher multiplier suppresses faint CMEs; lower multiplier causes excessive false-positive detections.

mathematical_role: Asymptotic consistency correction factor for median absolute deviation
scientific_justification: Mathematical identity: for a Gaussian distribution X ~ N(mu, sigma^2), 1.4826 * MAD(X) converges asymptotically to sigma.

consequences_of_change: Altering this factor violates mathematical consistency with Gaussian standard deviation.

mathematical_role: Inner boundary of quiet outer coronal annulus for floor estimation
scientific_justification: Corresponds to ~11 solar radii where background streamer intensity has flattened to a stable outer baseline.
evidence: COR2 instrumental vignetting and streamer gradient models show asymptotic plateau beyond 11 Rsun.
consequences_of_change: Too small includes dense streamer belt; too large leaves insufficient radial ring width before FOV edge.

mathematical_role: Outer boundary of quiet outer coronal annulus for floor estimation

consequences_of_change: Exceeding 120 px samples invalid vignetted border pixels; reducing it narrows the sample count.

mathematical_role: Hard lower bound on effective P04 detection threshold in D4

mathematical_role: Minimum 4x4 patches required for a connected component before tracking
scientific_justification: Filters out isolated 1- to 7-patch noise speckles, focusing tracker computational effort on coherent CME structures.
evidence: Reconciles historical 20-track count (no pre-size gate) with 8-track clean count on 2010-12-12.
consequences_of_change: Setting to 1 admits thousands of noise tracks; setting >12 fragments developing CME components.

mathematical_role: Morphological connectivity for spatial connected component labeling
scientific_justification: 8-connectivity connects diagonally adjacent patches, preserving diagonal CME shock fronts and filamentary structures.
evidence: Standard 2D morphological topology for connected feature segmentation.
consequences_of_change: 4-connectivity artifically splits diagonal CME fronts into multiple disjoint fragments.

mathematical_role: Maximum consecutive missed observations before a track is terminated
scientific_justification: Enforces temporal continuity; in a 30-minute cadence, missing 2 consecutive frames represents 1.5 hours of unobserved flight.
evidence: A5b tracking specification and pilot study; CMEs at 500 km/s travel ~10 Rsun in 1.5 hours.
consequences_of_change: Higher value allows dead tracks to linger and re-associate with unrelated CMEs; lower value kills tracks on brief gaps.

mathematical_role: Whether to terminate active tracks upon encountering SPATIAL_QC frame
scientific_justification: Prevents unobserved tracks from bridging across corrupted observations and associating with new subsequent events.
evidence: Standard runner configuration for 2010-12-12 controlled evaluation.
consequences_of_change: Setting False allows tracks to survive across corrupted frames via predicted states.

mathematical_role: Maximum physical time gap between frames before terminating active tracks
scientific_justification: 75 minutes represents 2.5x nominal cadence; CMEs cannot be causally tracked across multi-hour gaps without telemetry.
evidence: Physical expansion distance at 1000 km/s exceeds the entire COR2 field of view in 2.5 hours.
consequences_of_change: Tighter gap terminates tracks during minor telemetry pauses; looser gap creates false associations.

mathematical_role: Initial half-width of Position Angle Region of Interest (ROI) for new tracks
scientific_justification: Covers 90 degrees full angular sector at birth, accommodating initial rapid lateral expansion of newborn CMEs.
evidence: Coronal CME statistical catalogs (St. Cyr et al. 2000) show median CME initial angular width is ~45-60 degrees.
consequences_of_change: Too narrow misses lateral expansion lobes; too wide admits unrelated features in opposing quadrants.

scientific_justification: Accommodates measurement uncertainty in component centroid Position Angle near sector boundaries.

consequences_of_change: Prevents clipping of peripheral CME components that graze the ROI boundary.

scientific_justification: Low alpha (0.10) provides high temporal inertia, preventing tracking CPA from jerking when peripheral fragments detach.
evidence: A5b lineage diagnostic showed alpha=0.1 maintains smooth radial propagation vectors across 32 frames.
consequences_of_change: Higher alpha makes CPA track peripheral noise; lower alpha prevents adaptation to legitimate non-radial CME deflection.

mathematical_role: Forward radial expansion tolerance for non-contact candidate eligibility
scientific_justification: In 256x256 grid (14.7 arcsec/px), 30 px in 30 min corresponds to ~1,600 km/s maximum forward CME speed.
evidence: CDAW SOHO/LASCO and STEREO CME speed distributions indicate >98% of CMEs travel below 1,600 km/s.
consequences_of_change: Tighter bound rejects fast CMEs; looser bound admits random outer-corona background fluctuations.

mathematical_role: Backward radial retreat tolerance for candidate component eligibility
scientific_justification: Accommodates apparent inward motion of trailing CME core structures due to variable illumination and cavity drainage.
evidence: Empirical observation in A4 multi-component tracking.
consequences_of_change: Too strict drops valid trailing CME substructure; too loose associates newly emerging unrelated eruptions.

mathematical_role: Allowed inward displacement tolerance for active track leading front
scientific_justification: Accommodates 1-patch (4 px) centroid quantization jitter in leading-front identification between frames.
evidence: Controlled outward gate experiment report (A0-A2 ablation).
consequences_of_change: Zero tolerance terminates valid CMEs during subtle front flattening; large tolerance defeats outward motion constraint.

mathematical_role: Maximum initial inner radius r_min for a newly birthed track
scientific_justification: Enforces solar root origin: CMEs must originate near the coronagraph occulting disk (inner edge ~16-22 px).
evidence: Solar physics requirement: CMEs originate from the solar surface and enter the FOV from the occulter.
consequences_of_change: Higher radius admits secondary debris and noise tracks born in the mid-corona as independent CMEs.

scientific_justification: 4 patches (16 pixels) corresponds to ~2 solar radii, providing a continuous proximity decay for jumping fronts.
evidence: A5b-NR mathematical design specification; prevents abrupt step function at contact boundary.

scientific_justification: Prevents excessively narrow angular kernels for thin newborn tracks, which would cause premature zero-collapse.

mathematical_role: Default CME expansion speed in pixels/sec for newborn tracks without history
scientific_justification: 0.005 px/s = 9.0 px/half-hour = ~450 km/s, matching the canonical median slow solar wind / quiet CME propagation speed.
evidence: Gopalswamy et al. (2009) CDAW SOHO CME catalog mean speed is 445 km/s.
consequences_of_change: Higher nominal velocity biases newborn tracks toward fast CMEs; lower velocity causes late front predictions.

mathematical_role: Upper clamp on causal front velocity estimation
scientific_justification: 0.025 px/s = 45 px/half-hour = ~2,250 km/s, bounding causal extrapolation within physically realistic coronal shock speeds.
evidence: Extreme coronal mass ejections rarely exceed 2,500 km/s (Yashiro et al. 2004).
consequences_of_change: Unclamped velocities lead to wild front over-predictions when centroid jitter occurs across single frames.

mathematical_role: Radial prediction uncertainty fraction: sigma_r = 0.15 * r_pred
scientific_justification: Models expanding radial uncertainty proportional to distance traveled from the Sun.
evidence: Standard physical dispersion model for self-similarly expanding coronal plasma structures.
consequences_of_change: Smaller fraction rejects valid accelerating fronts; larger fraction reduces kinematic discrimination.

mathematical_role: Equal-weight geometric mean exponent S_NR = (C * A * K * D)^(1/4)
scientific_justification: Mathematically enforces strictly equal weighting among all 4 independent evidence modalities without heuristic weights.
evidence: Core design goal of normalized tracking; removes arbitrary heuristic coefficients (4O + 2A + 6K + 3F).
consequences_of_change: Altering power breaks equal geometric weighting and reintroduces manual bias.

mathematical_role: Minimum patch area required for a frame to qualify under persistence gate
scientific_justification: Requires substantial CME mass (>=10 patches = 160 pixels) to distinguish macro-scale CMEs from small coronal jet puffs.
evidence: Size-qualified persistence gate audit on 2010-12-12 dataset.
consequences_of_change: Lowering admits minor transient streamer puffs; raising excludes small narrow CMEs.

mathematical_role: Minimum consecutive qualified pairs required to admit a CME family
scientific_justification: 3 pairs = 1.5 hours of continuous propagation, proving genuine persistent outward coronal ejection.
evidence: Physical definition of CME: coherent propagating plasma structure persisting across multiple observation epochs.
consequences_of_change: 1 pair admits transient cosmic ray / stray light glints; 4 pairs rejects rapidly dissipating narrow eruptions.

mathematical_role: Angular margin added to dynamic PA recovery corridor
scientific_justification: Accommodates faint lateral diffuse CME flank material just beyond the primary tracked component boundary.
evidence: Exp 12 v2 dynamic patch recovery calibration.
consequences_of_change: Too small clips diffuse flank mass; too large samples adjacent streamer noise.

mathematical_role: Forward radial expansion margin beyond predicted front for patch recovery
scientific_justification: 13.35 pixels (~1.7 solar radii) captures diffuse leading-edge shock and sheath plasma preceding the dense core.
evidence: Derived from Exp 12 v2 empirical optimization against SEEDS validation masks.
consequences_of_change: Smaller window misses faint leading shock; larger window admits unrelated forward background noise.

mathematical_role: Minimum pixel area for connected sub-patch island retention
scientific_justification: 16 pixels corresponds to exactly one full 4x4 patch, discarding isolated sub-patch noise specks inside recovered ROI.
evidence: Stage 26 island-first segmentation specification.
consequences_of_change: Lowering retains high-frequency salt-and-pepper noise; raising leaves gaps in faint trailing filamentary legs.

mathematical_role: Maximum area of enclosed dark holes filled morphologically
scientific_justification: Fills small morphological noise voids (<=16 px) while preserving physical dark CME cavities (>100 px).
evidence: Astronomical CME morphology: large low-density flux-rope cavities must not be artificially filled with synthetic mass.
consequences_of_change: Larger hole filling erroneously fills the true CME coronal cavity; zero hole filling leaves swiss-cheese segmentation.

mathematical_role: Inner radial cutoff for final pixel segmentation
scientific_justification: Excludes diffraction rings and optical flare scattering around the physical 16.3 px COR2 occulter disk.
evidence: Inspection of raw COR2 images shows intense optical diffraction artifacts between 16 and 22 pixels.
consequences_of_change: Lowering admits occulter diffraction spikes; raising discards inner CME core emergence.

mathematical_role: Outer radial cutoff for final pixel segmentation
scientific_justification: Matches the circular optical entrance aperture radius of the COR2 instrument (122.5 pixels in 256x256 grid).
evidence: COR2 optical ray tracing and instrument documentation.
consequences_of_change: Exceeding 122.5 px attempts to segment vignetted detector corners where data are unphysical.

mathematical_role: Nominal solar radius constant
scientific_justification: IAU 2015 Resolution B3 recommended nominal solar radius value (Prsa et al. 2016).
evidence: Official international astronomical standard.
consequences_of_change: Altering changes absolute physical velocity (km/s) and radial distance scales.

mathematical_role: Minimum observation points required for linear 1st-order polyfit kinematics
scientific_justification: Mathematical constraint: linear regression requires at least 3 points to compute meaningful residual variance and R^2.
evidence: Mathematical definition of linear regression degrees of freedom (N - 2 >= 1).
consequences_of_change: Fitting with 2 points yields trivial R^2 = 1.0 with zero degrees of freedom.

mathematical_role: Coefficient of determination threshold for EXPLORATORY speed classification
scientific_justification: R^2 >= 0.50 indicates linear expansion model accounts for at least 50% of the total radial front variance.
evidence: Standard empirical threshold for heuristic linear velocity classification in automated CME catalogs.
consequences_of_change: Higher threshold classifies moderately accelerating CMEs as LOW_CONFIDENCE; lower threshold accepts erratic noise fits.
